messages:
Anna Park: dropped two small comps in Figma—legend inline per-card vs global legend bar. also exploring where the token denom toggle (tokens / USD est) should live for org vs project scope. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def/billing-legend-ideas
Miguel Santos: looked—global legend keeps the canvas clean, but you lose per-card context. per-card mini-legend helps interpret stacked bars quickly.
Jaspreet Kaur: copy thought: label the toggle as 'Units: Tokens (est. USD)' not just 'Tokens / USD' so users know it's an estimate.
Rachel Li: a11y note: legend markers must be focusable or at least have aria-labels. screen readers need a textual mapping (e.g., 'Generation tokens, latency tokens').
Sam Ortiz: scoped behavior: if a user flips to Project view we should persist that choice in local storage and URL param. else they get bounced back to org by accident.
Lee Chen: agree persist, but ensure sharing a link keeps scope param. otherwise QA will be confusing.
Anna Park: proposal: header-level scope toggle (org / project) + a compact global legend that can be pinned. per-card mini-legend appears on focus/hover or when expanded. invoice CTA stays in expanded card top-right.
Miguel Santos: mobile caveat—hover mini-legend won't work. mobile should default to compact list with inline legend rows collapsed by default.
Jaspreet Kaur: download CTA copy: please use explicit labels like 'Download invoice (PDF)' and add a tiny chevron for more formats.
accessibility-bot: auto-audit: legend elements require accessible names; use aria-describedby for series descriptions; ensure color contrast for palette: teal (#2AA58A) fails AA on light theme for small markers.
Rachel Li: suggest teal -> #0B6E4F for markers, and ensure marker shapes are more distinct (dot + square) for colorblind users. also ensure legend entries are in DOM order.
Sam Ortiz: performance note: don't render all per-card mini-legends for 150+ project orgs. lazy-render on open/focus and use virtualization for list view.
Anna Park: action items: 1) Design to create header toggle + global legend + mobile list fallback (Anna/Miguel) 2) Frontend to prototype persisted scope + URL param + lazy mini-legend (Sam/Lee) 3) Jaspreet to update CTA copy and format labels 4) Rachel to run a11y checklist and swap palette. pairing session Thursday morning?
Miguel Santos: Thursday AM works for me.
Lee Chen: I'll help with the URL param spec.
Jaspreet Kaur: I'll draft the copy PR by Wed EOD.
Rachel Li: adding a11y notes to the figma and will run contrast checks.
Anna Park: sweet, thanks all :thumbsup:
